ex.en: The architect showed us the blueprints of the house.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看了房子的設計圖。

ex.en: The report is a blueprint for reform.
ex.zh: 這份報告是改革的藍圖。

ex.en: I always need an extra blanket in the wintertime.
ex.zh: 冬天我總是需要多加一條毯子。

ex.en: Can you give me a pillow and a blanket?
ex.zh: 可以給我一個枕頭和一條毯子嗎？

ex.en: How many blankets are there on the bed?
ex.zh: 床上有幾條毯子？

ex.en: Snow blanketed the city overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間，大雪覆蓋了整座城市。

ex.en: Thick fog blanketed the airport this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上濃霧籠罩了機場。

ex.en: The company has a blanket ban on smoking.
ex.zh: 公司全面禁止吸菸。

ex.en: We can't apply a blanket rule to every case.
ex.zh: 我們不能把同一套規則套用到每個案例。

ex.en: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
ex.zh: 請用適當的字詞填空。

ex.en: Write your name in the blank at the top.
ex.zh: 把你的名字寫在上方的空格裡。

ex.en: Please leave this page blank.
ex.zh: 這一頁請留白。

ex.en: I handed in a blank sheet of paper.
ex.zh: 我交了一張白紙。

blank.zh: （腦中）一片空白的；（表情）茫然的

ex.en: My mind was blank.
ex.zh: 我的腦袋一片空白。

ex.en: She gave me a blank look.
ex.zh: 她一臉茫然地看著我。

ex.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
ex.zh: 把混合物攪拌到滑順為止。

ex.en: Oil and water won't blend with each other.
ex.zh: 油和水無法互相混合。

ex.en: Blend the fruit with some milk to make a smoothie.
ex.zh: 把水果和一些牛奶打在一起做成果昔。

ex.en: His black coat blended into the darkness.
ex.zh: 他的黑色外套和黑暗融為一體。

ex.en: The new employee blended in with the team quickly.
ex.zh: 新員工很快就融入了團隊。

ex.en: This coffee is a blend of beans from Brazil and Kenya.
ex.zh: 這款咖啡混合了巴西和肯亞的豆子。

ex.en: The show offers a blend of music and comedy.
ex.zh: 這場表演結合了音樂和喜劇。

ex.en: Tom was injured in the blast.
ex.zh: 湯姆在爆炸中受傷。

ex.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
ex.zh: 廣播裡全是最近那場爆炸的新聞。

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整間房子。

ex.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
ex.zh: 一陣冰冷的強風讓我冷到骨子裡。

ex.en: My neighbor blasts music late at night.
ex.zh: 我鄰居半夜把音樂開得很大聲。

ex.en: The radio was blasting pop songs all day.
ex.zh: 收音機整天大聲播著流行歌。

ex.en: We had a blast at the party last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在派對上玩得超開心。

ex.en: The kids had a blast at the water park.
ex.zh: 孩子們在水上樂園玩得很盡興。

ex.en: We have three dogs, one white and two black.
ex.zh: 我們有三隻狗，一隻白的、兩隻黑的。

ex.en: I have a black dog and a white dog.
ex.zh: 我有一隻黑狗和一隻白狗。

ex.en: I don't believe that black cats cause bad luck.
ex.zh: 我不相信黑貓會帶來厄運。

ex.en: How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要怎麼喝？濃的黑咖啡嗎？

ex.en: I always drink my coffee black.
ex.zh: 我喝咖啡都不加奶。

ex.en: She was dressed in black.
ex.zh: 她穿著一身黑。

ex.en: Black is my favorite color.
ex.zh: 黑色是我最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
ex.zh: 我想試穿那件藍色條紋裙。

ex.en: A white cloud is floating in the blue sky.
ex.zh: 一朵白雲在藍天上飄。

ex.en: He thinks that blue is the most beautiful colour.
ex.zh: 他覺得藍色是最美的顏色。

ex.en: Blue is a popular color for offices.
ex.zh: 藍色是辦公室常用的顏色。

ex.en: I have the blues today.
ex.zh: 我今天心情不太好。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit blue today.
ex.zh: 我今天心情有點低落。

blue.zh: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料

ex.en: It was like a bolt out of the blue.
ex.zh: 簡直是晴天霹靂。

ex.en: He called me out of the blue.
ex.zh: 他突然打電話給我。

ex.en: I'd like you to have a blood test.
ex.zh: 我希望你去驗個血。

ex.en: Very few people know what their blood group is.
ex.zh: 很少人知道自己是什麼血型。

ex.en: My blue dress appeared with a blood stain.
ex.zh: 我的藍色洋裝上出現了血跡。

ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.
ex.zh: 北方吹來一陣冷風。

ex.en: She had her hat blown off by the wind.
ex.zh: 她的帽子被風吹走了。

ex.en: Tom blew out all the candles on the cake.
ex.zh: 湯姆吹熄了蛋糕上所有的蠟燭。

ex.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
ex.zh: 許個願，然後吹蠟燭吧。

ex.en: Losing the contract was a big blow to the company.
ex.zh: 失去這份合約對公司是一大打擊。

ex.en: His death came as a blow to his family.
ex.zh: 他的死對家人是沉重的打擊。

ex.en: They blamed Tom for causing the accident.
ex.zh: 他們指責湯姆造成了事故。

ex.en: He only blames other people, and never himself.
ex.zh: 他只會怪別人，從不檢討自己。

ex.en: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.
ex.zh: 現在怪他造成事故也沒用了。

ex.en: The manager took the blame for the mistake.
ex.zh: 經理為這個錯誤扛下了責任。

ex.en: Don't put the blame on me.
ex.zh: 別把責任推到我身上。

ex.en: It is you that are to blame for it.
ex.zh: 該負責的是你。

ex.en: Tom and Mary have nobody to blame but themselves.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗只能怪自己。

ex.en: The old man is blind in one eye.
ex.zh: 這位老人一隻眼睛看不見。

ex.en: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.
ex.zh: 盲人的聽覺通常非常敏銳。

ex.en: Tom opened the blinds and looked out the window.
ex.zh: 湯姆拉開百葉窗，往窗外看。

ex.en: Could you close the blinds? The sun is too bright.
ex.zh: 你可以把百葉窗關上嗎？陽光太刺眼了。

ex.en: Love blinded him to her faults.
ex.zh: 愛情讓他看不見她的缺點。

ex.en: He was blinded in an accident.
ex.zh: 他在一次意外中失明了。

ex.en: Because American dramas are very bloody, he doesn't like watching them.
ex.zh: 因為美劇很血腥，所以他不喜歡看。

ex.en: The war was long and bloody.
ex.zh: 那場戰爭漫長又血腥。

ex.en: He had a bloody nose after the fall.
ex.zh: 他跌倒後流鼻血了。

ex.en: God bless you!
ex.zh: 願上帝保佑你！

ex.en: The priest blessed the newly married couple.
ex.zh: 神父為新婚夫婦祝福。

ex.en: I am blessed with good health.
ex.zh: 我很幸運擁有健康的身體。

ex.en: Taiwan is blessed with beautiful mountains.
ex.zh: 台灣得天獨厚，擁有美麗的山。

bless.zh: Bless you!：（對打噴嚏的人說）保重

ex.en: "Achoo!" "Bless you!"
ex.zh: 「哈啾！」「保重！」

ex.en: Bless you! Do you need a tissue?
ex.zh: 保重！你需要面紙嗎？

ex.en: I've just published a new post on my blog.
ex.zh: 我剛在部落格上發表了一篇新文章。

ex.en: I often read English and Chinese blogs online.
ex.zh: 我常上網看英文和中文的部落格。

ex.en: Do you have a blog?
ex.zh: 你有部落格嗎？

ex.en: She blogs about travel and food.
ex.zh: 她在部落格上寫旅遊和美食。

ex.en: I've been blogging for five years.
ex.zh: 我寫部落格已經五年了。

ex.en: The soup is a bit bland. Can you pass the salt?
ex.zh: 這湯有點淡，可以把鹽遞給我嗎？

ex.en: Hospital food is often bland.
ex.zh: 醫院的伙食通常很淡。

ex.en: This novel is too bland.
ex.zh: 這本小說太乏味了。

ex.en: Life would become bland without you.
ex.zh: 沒有你，我的生活會變得平淡無味。

ex.en: Walk two blocks, and turn left.
ex.zh: 走過兩個街區，然後左轉。

ex.en: She lives a block away and her name is Susan.
ex.zh: 她住在一個街區之外，名叫蘇珊。

ex.en: After the storm, the road was blocked with fallen trees.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，那條路被倒下來的樹堵住了。

ex.en: Traffic was blocked by a landslide.
ex.zh: 交通因為山崩而中斷。

ex.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是由櫻木雕刻而成。

ex.en: The building is made of concrete blocks.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是用混凝土塊蓋的。

ex.en: His wounded leg began to bleed again.
ex.zh: 他受傷的腿又開始流血了。

ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。

ex.en: We have to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 我們必須止血。
